Feature release adding richer status feedback, better notifications, and distribution improvements.

## Highlights

- Added menu bar color modes: monochrome, colorful, and colorful only when usage is low.
- Added reset notifications for 5 hour and weekly limits.
- Added error state visibility directly in the menu bar.
- Improved last-updated formatting by showing dates for older refreshes.
- Added MIT license.
- Added Homebrew tap publishing automation.
- Expanded tests around formatting, notifications, preferences, and usage state behavior.
- Updated README with installation and usage details.
